notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and favicon, but not a preview image.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are prevented and the existing card is targeted, but editing is not opened or reliably guided when filtered or archived.
REF-BM-14: #tag is tokenized as ordinary full-text, so it can match non-tag fields.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized groups are not implemented; all tokens are joined with AND.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No action can target the full currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written but are displayed as plain text rather than rendered Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot implementation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles or saved filter combinations are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import preserves title/date and derives tags from folders, but does not preserve explicit TAGS attributes.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
